text: When our parents are alive, we should treat them with love and respect. When they are dead, we should have sorrow for them. By doing so we shall have performed the duty of mankind, and have done what ought to be done by a filial son, and by the living to the dead.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
speaker: Confucius
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter XVIII, Mourning for One's Parents
